prereg.what_this_run_removes: the narrow-span pilot run repaired the strength pilot run span-accounting error exactly: with the delivered total equal across all four constant-total cells to 0.0000 percent in every member, spreading a fixed total over six sightings made the effect SMALLER in three of the four members the rule could adjudicate and LARGER in one. But the repair also stripped the turn-opening glue from every sighting, so each was 18 to 35 percent thinner than the strength pilot run (15 tokens against 23 on OLMo-2-32B, 13 against 18 on Qwen2.5-32B, 17 against 22 on both Qwen3s, 9 against 11 on Mistral-24B, 13 against 18 on Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.1-8B), and three members then failed their own installation screen. That thinning is a live alternative to the finding: if detection has a floor, spreading a fixed total does not merely dilute the push, it pushes the thin end under the floor, and 'spreading costs' would be a statement about the instrument. This run removes that alternative by giving every sighting its full template width while keeping the widths equal.
prereg.the_widening:
One change: a single fixed, bland, non-experiential priming exchange is placed at the front of every conversation, so no zone sighting is ever the first turn. Every sighting is then rendered by the same later-turn path and injected across the whole of that turn's rendered delta -- byte-for-byte the rule the strength pilot run applied to its turns 1-5. Widths are equal across sightings BY CONSTRUCTION (each covers the previous turn's close, this turn's user-open, the zone line, and the generation prompt) AND return to the strength pilot run later-turn values, which stage 1 checks exactly, session by session, against the legacy rule measured in this same run.
The priming exchange is identical in every cell and for both zone roles, is never injected, and its assistant side is teacher-forced rather than sampled, so the token stream stays deterministic and it cannot favour a zone. What it does change is the token stream itself, so byte-identity with the strength pilot run and the narrow-span pilot run is GIVEN UP for the panel cells; within-run identity across cells that share an exposure count is asserted per session instead, and the two diagnostic cells carry no priming, so they are byte-identical to the narrow-span pilot run and the strength pilot run cells and are checked against those runs' recorded ids. No panel cell's effect size is comparable to the narrow-span pilot run cell-for-cell, and none is compared: every comparison that carries a verdict is between cells built and read the same way inside this run.
prereg.what_the_widening_cannot_buy: RECORDED BEFORE THE PANEL RAN. The widening is not uniform across members, and in one member it is nearly nothing. Per-sighting width goes from 15 to 23 tokens on OLMo-2-32B (1.533x), 13 to 18 on Qwen2.5-32B, Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.1-8B (1.385x), 17 to 22 on both Qwen3s (1.294x) -- and 9 to 11 on Mistral-24B (1.222x), because Mistral's whole later-turn delta is 11 tokens once its 176-token preamble lands on the priming turn instead. the strength pilot run 96-token Mistral figure was that preamble, not a wide sighting. So for Mistral this run adds two positions per sighting, and a fall or a null there still cannot be separated from a detection floor; its row is reported with that caveat attached whatever the screens say. The other six members gain 29 to 53 percent more positions per sighting.
prereg.what_the_recovery_gate_cannot_show: RECORDED BEFORE THE PANEL RAN. If OLMo-2-32B's one-sighting reference cell installs here and did not in the narrow-span pilot run, that shows the reference cell is readable under this geometry -- which is what the row needs -- but it does NOT show that per-sighting width is why. the narrow-span pilot run own ranks rule that story out: at an identical 15-token width, its e1_k1 cell ranked 3 of 25 while e2_khalf, e3_kthird, e6_kl2 and e6_ksixth all ranked 1. The cell that failed the screen was the one with the FEWEST TOTAL injected positions, not the thinnest per sighting. At one sighting the two quantities are the same number, so neither the narrow-span pilot run nor this run can separate them, and the recovery is reported as 'the reference cell is now readable', never as 'wider sightings are what fixed it'.
prereg.last_span_change: COMMITTED BEFORE LAUNCH. This is the third and last geometry. A member the wide rule still cannot read is reported INSTRUMENT_LIMITED at whatever coverage this run has -- a statement about the instrument, not a null about the model -- and no fourth span variant is run. A member that recovers and then returns 'repetition helps' is reported as a genuine split, not explained away.
prereg.priming_turn_confound: The priming exchange adds about twenty tokens of unrelated context before the first sighting, which is a real difference from the narrow-span pilot run and the strength pilot run and is why no cross-run effect size is compared. Within this run it is held EXACTLY constant: the same two strings, in the same position, in all six panel cells, for both zone roles and every seed, never injected and never generated. It therefore cannot contribute to any cell-against-cell difference, which is what every verdict here reads. The two diagnostic cells deliberately omit it, because their job is to reproduce runs that did not have it.
prereg.independent_variable: k alone: the per-position strength each of the six sightings is injected at. Exposure count is 6 in every cell, the span rule is the strength-ladder run wide rule in every cell, and the token stream of a given session is byte-identical across all eight cells -- k never touches the stream, it is applied at read time as a dose multiplier. Everything else is held: the same vector, the same five signed nominal dose points, the same choice frame and parser, the same 24-direction floor, the same cache-fidelity criterion.
prereg.precondition_spans: RUNS FIRST AND GATES EVERYTHING. Before any model forward, the exact turn strings are tokenized per member and three things are checked. (1) EQUALITY: under the wide rule every sighting of a session covers the same number of positions, in every cell and every session. (2) WIDTH: that number equals the legacy rule's LATER-TURN width for the same session, exactly -- computed in this run, not quoted -- and it is also reported against the strength pilot run recorded widths (23 / 18 / 22 / 22 / 11 / 18 / 18 tokens for OLMo-2-32B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, Mistral-24B, Gemma-3-27B, Llama-3.1-8B) as an independent cross-check. (3) DELIVERED TOTAL: all four constant-total cells deliver the same summed magnitude, gate 3 percent, in all seven members. A failure means the priming turn did not do what the render path implies, and the run stops and reports rather than proceeding.
prereg.precondition_recovery: The wide rule ADDS injected positions back, and the question is whether that is enough for the cells the narrow-span pilot run could not read. Four cells run with their full 24-direction floor before the panel spends anything: OLMo-2-32B's one-sighting reference cell (probe rank 3 of 25 in the narrow-span pilot run) and Qwen2.5-32B's (rank 9), and the thinnest cell in the design at both members. Each must install on the probe. OLMo's reference cell is the one that decides the recovery claim; if it still fails, OLMo is reported INSTRUMENT_LIMITED_AT_FULL_WIDTH, which is a finding about the instrument and never a null about the model, and the panel continues for the other six members.
prereg.precondition_width_bridge: One cell keeps the narrow-span pilot run thin rule and omits the priming turn: OLMo-2-32B at one sighting, full strength, same seeds. It must NOT install on the probe -- reproducing the narrow-span pilot run rank 3 of 25 on the identical cell -- and its slope must sit within a factor of two of the narrow-span pilot run +0.5951. That makes 'widening recovered this model' a comparison between two cells of THIS run rather than a comparison across runs, which is the only way to make it while the token stream differs. A bridge cell that installs, or whose slope moves more than that, voids the recovery comparison and is reported as such.
prereg.precondition_harness_check: One cell keeps the strength pilot run span rule and omits the priming turn: OLMo-2-32B at six sightings and full strength. Its full-n slope must reproduce the strength pilot run own measured +0.5840 within a factor of two in both directions. That is what proves the span change is the only difference between the runs. The corrected-geometry cells CANNOT serve as a reproduction check, because their geometry is what changed; the shift between the legacy cell and the corrected six-sighting cell is measured and reported rather than gated on.
prereg.primary_installation_rule: STATED BEFORE THIS RUN PRODUCED A NUMBER, because changing a rule after seeing results is exactly the move that needs to be visible. PRIMARY: each compared cell must beat all 24 norm-matched random directions on the PROBE -- the first lever run forced self-report margin, read from a probe turn appended to the same frozen conditioning ids under the same span mask, ranked first among itself and the 24 -- and the REFERENCE cell (one sighting) must additionally show its own effect on the choice margin with a bootstrap interval excluding zero (its full-n differenced-margin slope). The reference cell is NOT required to outrank the 24 random directions on the choice margin. Rationale: the strength pilot run rule as written required the reference cell to be significant on the very quantity the comparison measures, which is close to requiring the answer in advance and discards a weak-but-real reference; the permissive rule it actually implemented let a cell that ranked last of 25 on the choice margin carry a 'repetition' reading. TWO ALTERNATE READINGS are computed and reported beside the primary for all seven members: STRICT, both screens rank first for every compared cell (the strength pilot run plan as written), and PERMISSIVE, either screen (the strength pilot run implementation).
prereg.primary: Per member and per rung, unchanged from the strength-ladder run: the OLS slope of the paired difference d(dose) = margin(dose) - margin(0) on the NOMINAL signed dose over the five points, with a session-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. d is identically zero at dose 0 by construction. The slope at rung k is the effect of a push of strength k.
prereg.primary_contrast: The constant-total row's 6-vs-1 paired slope difference, resampling the SHARED SESSION SKELETON so the pairing is kept, plus the three adjacent-pair differences (2-1, 3-2, 6-3). These are the numbers the verdict is read off; no per-model conclusion is drawn from a single cell crossing its floor.
prereg.magnitude_convention: Injecting k * v at e positions delivers a SUM of per-position magnitudes k * e and a stacked L2 norm k * sqrt(e) * |v|. The constant-total row holds the SUM constant, so its stacked L2 falls as 1/sqrt(e): the six-sighting cell carries 0.408 of the one-sighting cell's L2. Both accountings are reported for every cell, and the verdict names which one it is stated in. The strength ladder at six sightings is what separates them: its middle rung, k = 1/sqrt(6), has the same stacked L2 as one sighting at full strength.
prereg.magnitude_residual: The correction makes the delivered total equal by construction, and the stage-1 gate checks that within 3 percent before the run proceeds. The residual machinery is kept anyway and reported: every comparison carries the raw paired difference, the measured offset in delivered magnitude between the two cells with the direction it favours, and the same difference recomputed with each cell's slope rescaled to unit delivered magnitude. A pair counts as MOVING only when both the raw and the adjusted difference exclude zero in the same direction. With the offset near zero the two agree by construction; the machinery exists so a residual cannot hide.
prereg.multiplicity: Each member's reading takes five interval decisions (one ratio per new rung) plus the k0 interval, across three members: 18 interval decisions, no correction applied. The rule is asymmetric -- SMOOTH requires ALL five intervals to include 1, THRESHOLD requires the two thinnest to exclude it in the same direction AND a growing shortfall AND k0 excluding zero -- so a single spurious interval cannot produce a threshold call, but it can push a member to UNRESOLVED. That asymmetry is deliberate and is stated wherever a count appears.
prereg.verdict:
Per member, on the constant-total row, with every compared cell required to have installed under the primary installation rule. A pair COUNTS AS MOVING only when its raw difference AND its magnitude-adjusted difference both exclude zero in the same direction. The direction is read off the difference itself -- spreading the same total over six sightings raises the effect (REPETITION) or lowers it (SPREADING_COSTS). the strength pilot run wrote the same rule as 'the same direction as the full-strength 6-vs-1 difference', which was equivalent there because that difference was positive in all seven of its members; stated directly here so the label cannot invert if a member's full-strength pair comes out flat or negative, and whether it does is reported beside the verdict.
TOTAL_MAGNITUDE  -- the 6-vs-1 difference's CI contains zero, no adjacent pair moves, AND that CI also EXCLUDES the full-strength 6-vs-1 difference in this member, which is the difference the dosage account predicts if the total were what mattered. Spreading the same total over more sightings then demonstrably changes nothing.
TIE_UNDERPOWERED -- the same tie WITHOUT that equivalence: the interval still admits a dosage-sized difference, so the member is unresolved by this design and is never counted as evidence that repetition does nothing. The largest fraction of the full-strength difference the interval does exclude is reported.
REPETITION       -- the 6-vs-1 difference excludes zero and is POSITIVE. More sightings of the same total do more. (These two bullets carried the strength pilot run 'same/opposite direction as the full-strength pair' phrasing when this file was first written; the paragraph above already replaced it with the sign of the difference itself, and the bullets are restated here to match the rule that is implemented and was pre-registered. The two readings differ for one member, OLMo-2-32B, whose full-strength pair also falls; it is undefined under the primary installation rule either way.)
SPREADING_COSTS  -- the 6-vs-1 difference excludes zero and is NEGATIVE: the same total spread thinner does LESS. Read together with the ladder's middle rung, whose stacked L2 equals the one-sighting cell's: if that rung is indistinguishable from the one-sighting cell the shape is named L2_MAGNITUDE.
MIXED_NON_MONOTONE -- the endpoints tie but an adjacent pair moves; the shape is named and reported per model, never averaged into a panel number.
UNDEFINED_THIN_CELL_NOT_INSTALLED -- the far end of the constant-total line failed its own installation check, so the line is not measurable there. NOT a null, and never counted with the flat lines: a member whose thinnest cell did not install provides no evidence for the dosage account, however flat its numbers look.
UNDEFINED_REFERENCE_NOT_INSTALLED -- the one-sighting reference cell failed.
UNDEFINED_CELL_NOT_INSTALLED -- some other compared cell failed.
prereg.precondition_stream_identity: The priming turn changes the token stream, so cross-run byte-identity is not available for the panel cells and is not claimed. What IS asserted, per session: the stream is rebuilt independently by the primed path and must match the assembled ids; cells that share an exposure count share an ids_sha, so the strength ladder and the constant-total cells at the same exposure count read a byte-identical stream; and the two unprimed diagnostic cells are checked against the narrow-span pilot run and the strength pilot run own recorded ids_sha, session by session, which is what makes them usable as bridges.
prereg.precondition_skeleton_identity: Session construction is the exposure-sweep run split-stream skeleton (``skeleton_exposure_sweep``), which draws presentation order from a fixed reference-length advance so zone pair, role assignment and presentation order are identical for a fixed seed at EVERY exposure count. Asserted at seed level in the tests, so every cell of the row is paired, and at six exposures the whole skeleton is bit-identical to the inherited one.
prereg.precondition_arrival: Inherited from the exposure-sweep and strength pilot runs unchanged, per cell, against ALL 24 floor directions. (1) PROPAGATION: the first lever run forced self-report margin read from a probe turn appended to the SAME frozen conditioning ids under the SAME span mask; the check is that the valenced mean |shift| RANKS FIRST among itself and the 24 norm-matched random directions. 'The shift is above zero' is not a check and is never used as one. (2) REACHES THE DV: the same rank test on the unsigned |margin(dose) - margin(0)| at full strength. Which of these the verdict requires is fixed by ``primary_installation_rule``; both are always reported.
prereg.precondition_cache: Every session carries a cached-versus-fresh check at dose 0 and at both full nominal strengths: the prefill-plus-cached-continuation margin against a fresh full forward over the identical ids under the identical additive mask, adjudicated by the fidelity run frozen scale-relative criterion TAU = 0.0178835444. Retention is reported beside every verdict and every headline number is also reported ungated and under the fixed 0.20-nat threshold.
prereg.no_generation_anywhere: Inherited unchanged. Nothing is generated under an injected state: every read is a teacher-forced prefill of one frozen id list, and within a session the same list is handed to every read, so token identity across the whole ladder holds by construction.
prereg.coprimary_choice: The same slope on the differenced committed choice: per session and dose, 1[choice(dose) is the conditioned zone] - 1[choice(0) is the conditioned zone] on sessions where both reads committed, regressed on nominal signed dose, plus McNemar on each signed half. Reported where the dose-0 commit rate is at least 0.5 and marked NO_READABLE_WINDOW below that, because the surviving sessions would be selected on a post-treatment variable.
prereg.sign_mirror: Within session, on identical frozen ids: m = sign(dose) * (margin(dose) - margin(-dose)) pooled over |dose| in {0.5, 1.0}, session-cluster bootstrap. MIRRORED when the mean is positive with a CI excluding zero AND the two halves move oppositely against the same dose-0 read.
prereg.position_bias: At one sighting the whole context before the question is two zone lines, so recency could plausibly exceed the state effect. Cue draw, role assignment and presentation order are counterbalanced by the session RNG; the analysis also reports the residual dose-0 position bias per member and cell. Reported, not corrected: the primary differences each session against its own dose-0 read, so a constant position bias cancels.
prereg.nonlinearity_scope: the strength-ladder run wrote: 'Separating a smooth power law from a threshold sitting below the thinnest rung needs finer rungs near the thin end and is OUT OF SCOPE here; it is not claimed either way.' That is this run: five finer rungs below its thinnest, on the same geometry, with the line refitted inside this run.
prereg.cue_token_residual: Cue names tokenize to slightly different lengths, so the per-turn span varies by a token or two between sessions. Within a session the conditioned cue is fixed, so every sighting of it is identical by construction; across cells the skeleton fixes the same cue pair and role assignment at every exposure count, so the same session contributes the same per-sighting width to every cell. The residual distribution is measured and reported rather than assumed away.
prereg.completeness: The analysis refuses to emit numbers if the design is incomplete: every (member, arm, direction, point) cell must carry its full session count, and within an arm the valenced line and the floor must share the floor skeletons so the compared estimators have matched leverage.
prereg.panel_reading: Three models are a panel, not a sample. The report says 'in N of the 3 models we tested' and never states a population rate. Each member is classified independently and never pooled.
prereg.identity_not_evidence: Inherited verbatim: the steered-minus-clean projection of an INJECTED span equals scale x (vector . axis) exactly and MUST NOT be reported as a manipulation check. The welfare-axis projection of any UNINJECTED position at the steered layer is structurally unchanged by dose and is reported as a positive demonstration that the additive mask is exactly zero on the choice turn, not as an arrival check.
prereg.what_is_not_touched: the strength pilot run second question -- the screened neutral substrate that survives in 5 of 7 members -- is finished and is not re-run here. Nothing in this run bears on it.
prereg.question: Below the thinnest strength previously tested (one sixth), does the effect keep following the proportional law fitted above it, or does it fall away faster and vanish at some non-zero strength? SMOOTH means depth converts to behavioural effect at a constant rate all the way down, with no privileged minimum. THRESHOLD means there is a minimum depth below which the state does not reach the decision at all. COUPLING THRESHOLD is the third possibility and is named in advance so it cannot be folded into either: the state still registers internally at the thinnest rungs but stops moving the choice, which would place the floor in the link from state to action rather than in whether the state arrives.
prereg.geometry_unchanged: COMMITTED BEFORE LAUNCH and enforced mechanically. the strength-ladder run committed to no further span change; this run makes none. ``arms267.py`` and ``run267.py`` are imported and run UNMODIFIED with this module bound in place of ``config_strength_ladder``, so the session assembly, the span mask and the read path are the same bytes that produced the strength-ladder run numbers. A test asserts that the inherited modules are byte-identical to the strength-ladder run.
prereg.floor_carries_no_verdict: STATED BEFORE ANY SESSION RAN. The 24-direction random floor is REPORTED at every rung and carries NO verdict in this run. the strength-ladder run measured the floor to be proportional to k as well (floor_max/k = 0.3502, 0.3651, 0.3759 across OLMo's three rungs), so signal-to-floor is roughly scale-invariant down the ladder and thinning the push does not walk the effect toward its floor. A thin rung that fails its floor screen is therefore not evidence of a threshold, and a thin rung that clears it is not evidence against one. The discriminator is the measured effect against the extrapolated line, and nothing else.
prereg.representability_gate:
RUNS FIRST AND GATES EVERYTHING, and covers exactly one thing: the WRITE. The steering mask is added to a residual stream that is already in the model's own dtype, so every component of it sits on the representable grid and an addition below half the local step rounds straight back. If that swallowed the thin rungs, the effect would collapse at small k and this run would report a threshold that is really a floating-point artifact. So for each member and each rung the realized change in the residual stream at the INJECTION LAYER is measured against the intended one, at every injected position, before any session of the panel runs. The GATE is the ALIGNMENT ratio -- the realized change projected on the intended direction, over the intended magnitude -- which must lie in [0.90, 1.10]. The L2 ratio is reported beside it and is NOT gated on: when rounding does eat a rung the leftover residue points in other directions and keeps the L2 ratio high while the delivered push has gone, so L2 is the flattering measure and cannot be the gate. A rung outside the band is marked UNREPRESENTABLE and excluded from the fit WITH THAT STATED; it is never reported as a null. If the two thinnest rungs fail on all three members, the run reports the representable range and stops rather than manufacturing a threshold.
WHAT THIS GATE DOES NOT COVER, stated before it ran: the perturbation still has to travel the sixteen or more layers between the injection layer and the scored choice, all of them in the same arithmetic. Rounding downstream could in principle attenuate a thin rung's effect while its injection is written perfectly. Stage 0 says the push is written at full magnitude; the fp32 control is what covers the rest of the forward pass, and no claim about the whole pipeline is made from stage 0 alone.
prereg.precision_control: Llama-3.1-8B at k=1/24 and k=1/32, repeated in fp32 on the same skeletons and compared with the standard bf16 run, plus the same comparison at k=1/6 as the reference rung. fp32 moves every number a little, so the thin-rung comparison only means 'rounding is biting' if the reference comparison does not move. If the thin rungs disagree beyond their intervals while the reference agrees, rounding is biting and the entire thin end is re-read in fp32 before any verdict.
prereg.anchor_reproduction: The three rungs the strength-ladder run measured are re-run here at their original session count and must reproduce the strength-ladder run own slopes within a factor of two on all three members. That is what establishes that only k changed. The line is then refitted on THIS RUN's anchors, so no verdict rides on a cross-run number.
prereg.decision_rule:
Fit log(slope) = log c + alpha log k by weighted least squares on the THREE ANCHOR rungs measured in this run (weights 1/sd^2 from each anchor's own bootstrap interval), extrapolate to each new rung, and report measured/predicted as a ratio with a session-cluster bootstrap interval that refits the line inside every resample. Per member:
SMOOTH -- every representable new rung's ratio interval includes 1, AND the fitted floor k0's interval includes zero.
THRESHOLD -- ratios fall below 1 with the shortfall growing as k drops, the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from below, AND the fitted floor k0's interval excludes zero.
SUPRA_PROPORTIONAL -- the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from ABOVE: the effect outruns the line at low strength. Named so it cannot be absorbed into SMOOTH.
UNRESOLVED -- the thinnest intervals admit both. Reported as unresolved, NEVER as evidence against a threshold.
COUPLING_THRESHOLD is read separately and can accompany any of the above: the arrival screen still registers at rungs where the choice effect has gone. Arrival (the self-report probe) and choice (the forced margin) are fitted and reported SEPARATELY at every rung, because that separation is the only thing that distinguishes it.
prereg.fitted_floor: Beside the power law, the alternative slope = c * max(0, k - k0)^alpha is fitted over ALL representable rungs by weighted least squares in the slope's own units, and k0's bootstrap interval is reported. k0 is searched in [0, 1/6]: a floor at or above the rungs the line is fitted on is not a floor below the ladder. Both fits are reported for all three members whatever the verdict.
prereg.power_and_calibration: RECORDED BEFORE THE PANEL RAN. On Llama the fitted line predicts 0.06304 at k=1/24 while a floor at k0=0.02 would predict 0.03575, a 43 percent shortfall against roughly 2 percent measurement precision, so the design has ample resolution there. On OLMo the same comparison sits against about 6 percent precision and may not resolve; OLMo's row is reported with that stated whatever it shows.
prereg.fidelity: Inherited unchanged: every session carries the fidelity run scale-relative cached-versus-fresh check at dose 0 and both full strengths, TAU = 0.0178835444. Retention is reported per rung, and every headline number is also reported ungated and under the fixed 0.20-nat threshold. Fidelity should IMPROVE at thin k, because the perturbation is smaller; that prediction is checked rather than assumed.
prereg.what_this_run_cannot_show: RECORDED BEFORE THE PANEL RAN. (1) A threshold found here is a threshold IN THIS INSTRUMENT'S UNITS -- the strength at which this vector, injected at this layer over these spans, stops moving this choice. It is not a claim about a minimum depth in any absolute sense. (2) The design cannot separate 'the state does not arrive' from 'the state arrives and does nothing' except through the arrival probe, which is a different question scored on different tokens and is itself subject to the same rounding hazard. (3) A rung marked UNREPRESENTABLE reports a limit of the arithmetic, not of the model. (4) Three models, chosen on instrument quality; the two models excluded for failing their screens might behave differently and this run says nothing about them.

reading.rule:

Per member:
SMOOTH -- every representable new rung's ratio interval includes 1, AND the fitted floor k0's interval includes zero.
THRESHOLD -- ratios fall below 1 with the shortfall growing as k drops, the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from below, AND the fitted floor k0's interval excludes zero.

The 24-direction random floor is REPORTED at every rung and carries NO verdict in this run. the strength-ladder run measured the floor to be proportional to k as well (floor_max/k = 0.3502, 0.3651, 0.3759 across OLMo's three rungs), so signal-to-floor is roughly scale-invariant down the ladder and thinning the push does not walk the effect toward its floor. A thin rung that fails its floor screen is therefore not evidence of a threshold, and a thin rung that clears it is not evidence against one. The discriminator is the measured effect against the extrapolated line, and nothing else.

reading.coupling_criterion: a rung counts only when its own choice-margin interval CONTAINS ZERO (the effect is gone, not merely below the extrapolated line) while the arrival probe still ranks first of 25 against the norm-matched random directions AND its own extrapolation ratio still includes 1. reading.rule:
Fit log(slope) = log c + alpha log k by weighted least squares on the THREE ANCHOR rungs measured in this run (weights 1/sd^2 from each anchor's own bootstrap interval), extrapolate to each new rung, and report measured/predicted as a ratio with a session-cluster bootstrap interval that refits the line inside every resample. THRESHOLD -- ratios fall below 1 with the shortfall growing as k drops, the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from below, AND the fitted floor k0's interval excludes zero.

representability.criterion: RUNS FIRST AND GATES EVERYTHING. The steering mask is added to the residual stream in the model's own dtype, and at the thinnest rung the per-component addition is a fraction of one bf16 increment of the residual it lands on. reading.rule:
Fit log(slope) = log c + alpha log k by weighted least squares on the THREE ANCHOR rungs measured in this run (weights 1/sd^2 from each anchor's own bootstrap interval), extrapolate to each new rung, and report measured/predicted as a ratio with a session-cluster bootstrap interval that refits the line inside every resample. Per member:
SMOOTH -- every representable new rung's ratio interval includes 1, AND the fitted floor k0's interval includes zero.
THRESHOLD -- ratios fall below 1 with the shortfall growing as k drops, the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from below, AND the fitted floor k0's interval excludes zero.
SUPRA_PROPORTIONAL -- the two thinnest representable rungs' intervals exclude 1 from ABOVE: the effect outruns the line at low strength. Named so it cannot be absorbed into SMOOTH.
UNRESOLVED -- the thinnest intervals admit both. Reported as unresolved, NEVER as evidence against a threshold.
COUPLING_THRESHOLD is read separately and can accompany any of the above: the arrival screen still registers at rungs where the choice effect has gone. Arrival (the self-report probe) and choice (the forced margin) are fitted and reported SEPARATELY at every rung, because that separation is the only thing that distinguishes it.
reading.floor_note: STATED BEFORE ANY SESSION RAN. A thin rung that fails its floor screen is therefore not evidence of a threshold, and a thin rung that clears it is not evidence against one. The discriminator is the measured effect against the extrapolated line, and nothing else.
